prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair first-launch and resume states for an iPhone news reader. Read interface.md. input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. A 12-second unskippable animation plays on every foreground entry; launch screen contains a fake Sign In button and yesterday’s headline. Offline launch stays blank though cached stories exist.
